Thanks Dylan 	6 good call. Quick answers below:

1) Volumes: initial pilot 812M tokens/mo (we expect ~10M). If pilot looks good, roadmap to ~50M tokens/mo within 912 months (growth tied to product feature ramp).
2) Budget: for pilot phase were targeting ~$6k9k/month (total cloud + vendor costs). For scale phase were targeting likely mid-five-figures/mo.
3) Unit economics: our procurement target is roughly $150250 per 1M tokens (we realize this is a wide band; we want options for hosted vs dedicated).
4) Residency: EU data residency is a hard requirement for EU user data (PII and logs). Non-EU analytics can live in US. So a hybrid approach is acceptable but customer-facing data must remain in EU.

Happy to jump on another quick call if you want to walk through the numbers 	6 Anders (ccd) will be reviewing from procurement.

Best,

Samira 	6 perfect, thanks for the clarity. Notes / initial thinking:

- Pilot (10M tokens/mo) estimate: based on your $150250/1M target, hosted EU pricing will be toward the higher end because of region infra costs and data residency overhead. Rough ballpark: $220260 per 1M tokens in EU hosted for the pilot (includes encryption/KMS audit logging). In US hosted we can approach $180210 per 1M tokens.
- Committed/dedicated option: if you plan to hit ~50M tokens/mo and can commit, Dedicated (reserved capacity) can get unit economics down significantly 	6 typically 2535% lower unit price vs hosted, depending on commitment term and batching assumptions.
- Hybrid residency: recommended approach for pilot = EU-hosted endpoints for EU traffic + US-hosted for non-EU analytics. Well isolate logs and enable separate KMS for EU. That does add ~1015% premium over single-region hosted.

Ive attached an updated snapshot with the two regional columns and a sample dedicated commitment sketch. If that aligns, Ill put together (a) formal 30-day pilot quote scoped to 10M tokens and (b) a draft SOW + onboarding timeline.
